notes: Pilgrim's Temple — scroll appearance pool. Run-random: appearances are generated via conlang.json weighted onsets/nuclei/codas (GenerateConlangWord) — 1-2 word tokens like "thae khor", "branel", "zae of orin". 8 appearances, 8 types, bijection per run. JSON appearances may be empty; generation is preferred. Fallback static pool is lower-case conlang style to keep potion/scroll namespaces distinct.

types.name: Teleport
types.desc: Teleports to a random floor tile

types.name: Fireball
types.desc: Deals 10 fire damage to adjacent enemies

types.name: Enchant
types.desc: Grants a random affix to one member

types.name: Confusion
types.desc: Confuses enemies for 8 turns (negative if misapplied)

types.name: Greater Healing
types.desc: Restores 20 HP to all living members

types.name: Summon Aid
types.desc: Summons a temporary ally for 15 turns
